thesis: CPU chat LLMs → GGUF Q4_K_M (llama.cpp) or BitNet → bitnet.cpp. Not sign()+torch.
llama_cpp_gguf: # Convert HF → GGUF (upstream convert scripts for the model family) then:
bitnet_cpp: git clone --recursive https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet.git BitNet && cd BitNet
# Optional: conda create -n bitnet-cpp python=3.10 && conda activate bitnet-cpp
# Windows: use VS2022 Developer shell; see upstream FAQs for ClangCL
# Inference (paths vary by OS): python run_inference.py -m models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T/ggml-model-i2_s.gguf -p 'Hello' -n 64

bitnet_b158_2b_4t_hf.note: Transformers/safetensors reference; production CPU serve still goes through bitnet.cpp.

requirements.windows: Developer Command Prompt / PowerShell for VS2022; ClangCL toolchain per upstream FAQs

this_repo_shims: bnn encode / bnn decode → .bnnpack for lab packed Linear artifacts
TernaryLinear + ternary_pack = pedagogy/size; speed for BitNet = bitnet.cpp

Do not claim this repo's XNOR kernels replace bitnet.cpp tokens/s
Do not vendor microsoft/BitNet as a default git submodule
